svg.title: Native Farmers headless e-commerce architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end flow: customer device hits Cloudflare CDN for read, Hetzner backend with Redis queue and BullMQ workers for write, integrated with Razorpay, Firebase, and Brevo.
svg.text: Reads served from edge CDN · Writes queued on origin
All third-party accounts owned and billed by Client · Vendor as collaborator only
Fully decoupled · storefront and backend deploy independently
